description.value: The 17 Mile House Liquor Shoppe is a retail liquor store attached to the historic 17 Mile House complex, a Sooke landmark that has welcomed travellers along this road since 1894. The store carries a broad selection of domestic and imported products with a particular emphasis on specialty BC wines, and hosts weekly Friday tasting events featuring local products. For cyclists passing through Sooke on the way to or from the Galloping Goose or Westshore trails, it offers a convenient resupply point with knowledgeable staff.
